findings.finding: The persisted pointer diagnostic is bounded to fixed enum categories, booleans/counts, and layout rectangles. Owner resolution maps known tab titles to a fixed panel key; ancestor tag, role, slot, state, and position values are allowlisted before return. No raw text, arbitrary attributes, class names, input values, URLs, Vault records, or screenshots are returned.
findings.qualification: The page-side helper does inspect paragraph text to compare it against four exact fixed strings and return only a fixed category. This does not expose arbitrary text, but is a larger read surface than owner/ancestor inspection strictly needs; remove it if the runtime diagnosis does not need those four labels.

findings.finding: Acceptance still uses the original unique-visible-target gate, clipped interior point hit-test, two stable follow-up samples, and trusted CDP mousePressed/mouseReleased. No DOM click, overlay dismissal, or click bypass was added.

runtime_diagnostic: not_run_by_peer; product behavior and actual emitted receipt remain unverified
authorization_boundary: The owner ruling permits fixed layout geometry for one diagnostic probe. It does not authorize a click bypass or product acceptance.
